title: Add Movement and Stress modules to dashboard

requirements.text: Add a MovementDay data type and stable storage to the backend actor that stores: date (Text), activeMinutes (Nat), activityType (variant: Walk, Run, Bike, Gym), and intensity (variant: Light, Medium, Intense). Implement CRUD endpoints: saveMovementDay and getMovementDay(date) gated by the existing role-based access control pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: saveMovementDay stores activeMinutes, activityType, and intensity keyed by date and caller principal
getMovementDay returns the stored entry for the given date
activityType accepts Walk, Run, Bike, Gym variants
intensity accepts Light, Medium, Intense variants
Endpoints are accessible only to authenticated users

requirements.text: Add a StressDay data type and stable storage to the backend actor that stores: date (Text), systolic (Nat), diastolic (Nat), and pulse (Nat). Implement CRUD endpoints: saveStressDay and getStressDay(date) gated by the existing role-based access control pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: saveStressDay stores systolic, diastolic, and pulse keyed by date and caller principal
getStressDay returns the stored entry for the given date
Endpoints are accessible only to authenticated users

requirements.text: Create a migration.mo that upgrades actor state to include the new movementDayEntries and stressDayEntries stable maps while preserving all existing data (profile, fasting, nutrition, sleep).
acceptanceCriteria: Migration preserves all pre-existing stable data
movementDayEntries and stressDayEntries are initialized as empty maps on upgrade

requirements.text: Add query keys for movement and stress to frontend/src/hooks/queryKeys.ts following the existing pattern used for nutrition and sleep.
acceptanceCriteria: movementDay and stressDay query key factories are exported from queryKeys.ts

requirements.text: Create frontend/src/hooks/useMovementQueries.ts providing useGetMovementDay and useSaveMovementDay hooks via the ICP actor, with cache invalidation on save and toast notifications, following the pattern in useSleepQueries.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: useGetMovementDay fetches today's movement entry
useSaveMovementDay persists the entry and invalidates the cache
Toast notification shown on success and error

requirements.text: Create frontend/src/hooks/useStressQueries.ts providing useGetStressDay and useSaveStressDay hooks via the ICP actor, with cache invalidation on save and toast notifications, following the pattern in useSleepQueries.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: useGetStressDay fetches today's stress entry
useSaveStressDay persists the entry and invalidates the cache
Toast notification shown on success and error

requirements.text: Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/MovementPanel.tsx — a dashboard panel for logging daily movement data. It must include: a numeric input for Active Minutes (0–300), a segmented selector or dropdown for Activity Type (Walk, Run, Bike, Gym), and a three-option toggle for Intensity (Light / Medium / Intense). Show a summary of the saved values and a Save button. Use the visual design language of SleepPanel and NutritionPanel (gradient accents, dark theme, consistent card style).
acceptanceCriteria: Active Minutes input accepts integers 0–300
Activity Type selector offers Walk, Run, Bike, Gym options
Intensity toggle offers Light, Medium, Intense options
Saved values are displayed in a summary view
Save button triggers useSaveMovementDay
Panel matches the dark gradient card style of existing panels

requirements.text: Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/StressPanel.tsx — a dashboard panel for logging daily blood pressure and pulse. It must include: numeric inputs for Systolic (mmHg), Diastolic (mmHg), and Pulse (bpm). Show a summary of the saved values with appropriate unit labels and a blood pressure display formatted as 'Sys/Dia mmHg'. Use the visual design language of SleepPanel and NutritionPanel.
acceptanceCriteria: Systolic input accepts integers (mmHg)
Diastolic input accepts integers (mmHg)
Pulse input accepts integers (bpm)
Blood pressure is displayed as 'Sys/Dia mmHg'
Save button triggers useSaveStressDay
Panel matches the dark gradient card style of existing panels

requirements.text: Add 'Movement' and 'Stress' as selectable factors in StartDashboard.tsx alongside the existing factors (Fasting, Nutrition, Sleep). Wire up the MovementPanel and StressPanel components so they render when their respective factor is selected, following the same conditional rendering pattern used for SleepPanel and NutritionPanel.
acceptanceCriteria: Movement and Stress appear as clickable factor markers in the helix spine
Selecting Movement renders MovementPanel
Selecting Stress renders StressPanel
Existing panels (Fasting, Nutrition, Sleep) remain unaffected

requirements.text: Add English and German translation strings to frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts for all new Movement and Stress UI labels: Active Minutes, Activity Type, Walk, Run, Bike, Gym, Intensity, Light, Medium, Intense, Blood Pressure, Systolic, Diastolic, Pulse, and any panel headings or button labels.
acceptanceCriteria: All new UI strings have both 'en' and 'de' entries in translations.ts
MovementPanel and StressPanel use the i18n hook for all visible text

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in the single main actor (backend/main.mo)
Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
Preserve all existing stable data and actor functionality (profile, fasting, nutrition, sleep)
nonGoals: Step counter or GPS-based activity tracking
Stress level score or mood inputs (not requested)
Charts or historical trend views for movement or stress data
Integration with any wearable or external health API
